announcements.headline: Eco Buildings Advances AI Factory Line on Budget
announcements.insight: Eco Buildings advances its AI factory line, following the first apartment block completion expected in Q4 2026. This operational update follows recent board changes and government engagement.

announcements.headline: First Apartment Block completion expected Q4 2026
announcements.insight: Completion of the first apartment block is expected in Q4 2026. This follows the August AGM trading update and recent board changes.

announcements.headline: Government Engagement in The Gambia
announcements.insight: Government engagement in The Gambia follows recent board changes. Shareholders should monitor for specific project details.

announcements.headline: Board Changes
announcements.insight: Board changes follow the AGM results. Shareholders should monitor how this governance shift impacts the AI platform and Albanian development progress.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM & Trading Update
announcements.insight: The AGM results confirm shareholder approval of the August loan note conversion. This update follows the June housing and AI platform developments.

announcements.headline: Conversion of Loan Notes & Issue of Equity
announcements.insight: Eco Buildings Group converts loan notes to equity, altering capital structure. This follows recent developments in housing and AI platforms.

announcements.headline: Eco Begins Work on AI-Enabled Housing Platform
announcements.insight: Eco Buildings Group plc begins work on an AI-enabled housing platform. This follows the June 2026 launch of Eco Buildings UK and a milestone apartment block development in Albania.

announcements.headline: Milestone apartment block development in Albania
announcements.insight: Eco Buildings Group plc announces a development milestone in Albania. This follows its June 2026 launch of Eco Buildings UK and subsequent general meeting results.

announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting
announcements.insight: Shareholders should monitor the outcome of this general meeting to see if it advances the housing opportunity launched in June.

announcements.headline: Launch of Eco Buildings UK: Housing Opportunity
announcements.insight: Eco Buildings Group plc launches Eco Buildings UK, a new housing opportunity. This marks the company's first recorded activity, signaling an initial strategic move for shareholders to monitor.
